title: Assigned T3 section wrappers become kit blocks without claiming unrelated elements
steps: Run the focused real-browser block-capture regression with Chromium installed. No model or running site is required.
expect: Three assigned T3 section modules sharing one position are distinct visible blocks.
Unassigned, unrelated, leading-zero and ambiguous identifiers are not claimed.
Hidden and off-canvas visibility, existing wrappers and T4 behavior remain intact.

tests: assigned T3 section chrome exposes each module without guessing layout or ambiguous ids
